create_display_handler: create a DisplayHandler instance with history size and extension types for pose visualization
register_key_callback: register a callback function to handle cv2 waitKey events in the DisplayHandler
register_post_render_callback: register a callback function to be called after rendering extension data on frames
update_frames: update the DisplayHandler with new capture frames and extension data for display
update_windows: update CV2 windows with current frames and process key presses at the given framerate
